description_en: Creates a hotspot parameter protection rule for HTTP requests
description_zh: 创建热点参数防护规则（HTTP 请求）
kebab_example: aliyun mse create-web-flow-rule --app-name spring-cloud-a --threshold 20.0 --resource /flow --resource-mode 0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWebFlowRule

parameters.help_en:
The rule status. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态
true(开启)
false(关闭)
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The interface name: The application resources to which the rule applies. The interface name must be the same as the name on the interface details page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 接口名称：适用该规则的应用资源。需要与控制台接口详情处接口名称一致
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en: The number of additional requests allowed for burst requests. The effect is equivalent to the maximum number of tokens of the token bucket algorithm
parameters.help_zh: 针对突发请求额外允许的请求数目（效果等同于令牌桶算法的最大令牌数）
parameters.name: burst

parameters.help_en:
The flow control method. Valid values:

0: fast failure

2: wait in queue
parameters.help_zh:
流控方式
0(快速失败)
2(排队等待)
parameters.name: control_behavior

parameters.help_en: The timeout period. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter is required if the ControlBehavior parameter is set to 2
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，流控效果为排队等待时需要设置，单位毫秒
parameters.name: max_queueing_time_ms

parameters.help_en:
The parameter description, which is a JSON string containing the following key-value pairs:

parseStrategy: the parameter property (0: client IP address, 1: remote host, 2: header, 3: URL parameter)

fieldName: the header name or URL parameter name. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3

matchStrategy: the method to match the property value. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3 and the property value is matched. Valid values: 0 (exact match), 2 (regular expression match), and 3 (substring match)

pattern: the match string. You must specify this key only if parseStrategy is set to 2 or 3 and the property value is matched
parameters.help_zh:
参数描述项，JSON格式的字符串，包含以下键值对
parseStrategy：参数属性（0: Client IP、1: RemoteHost、 2: Header、 3: URL参数）
fieldName：Header名称/URL参数名称，仅在参数属性为2、3时填写
matchStrategy：属性值匹配方式，仅在参数属性为2、3且需要属性值匹配时填写（0: 精确、 2: 正则、 3: 子串）
pattern：匹配串，仅在参数属性为2、3且需要属性值匹配时填写
parameters.name: param_item

parameters.help_en:
The threshold type. Valid values:

1 (number of requests)
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The length of the time window. Unit: milliseconds. The default value is 1000, which indicates 1 second
parameters.help_zh: 统计窗口时长（单位毫秒）：统计的时间窗口长度，默认值为1秒
parameters.name: stat_interval_ms

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

0: custom interface

1: WEB

2: RPC
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

Burst.description_en: The number of additional requests allowed for burst requests. The effect is equivalent to the maximum number of tokens of the token bucket algorithm
Burst.description_zh: 针对突发请求额外允许的请求数目（效果等同于令牌桶算法的最大令牌数）

Enable.description_en:

true: enabled

false: disabled
Enable.description_zh:
规则状态

true(开启)
false(关闭)

MaxQueueingTimeMs.description_en: The timeout period for queuing when the ControlBehavior parameter is set to 2. Unit: milliseconds
MaxQueueingTimeMs.description_zh: 流控效果为排队等待时对应的超时时间，单位毫秒

MetricType.description_en:
The threshold type. Valid values:

1: number of requests

pattern：匹配串，仅在参数属性为2、3且需要属性值匹配时填写

Resource.description_en: Interface name: the application resources to which the rule applies. The interface name must be the same as that displayed on the API details page in the console
Resource.description_zh: 接口名称：适用该规则的应用资源。需要与控制台接口详情处接口名称一致

StatIntervalMs.description_en: The length of the time window. Unit: milliseconds
StatIntervalMs.description_zh: 统计窗口时长（单位毫秒）：统计的时间窗口长度

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`: The request was successful.

`false`: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果，取值如下：
`true`：请求成功。
`false`：请求失败
